comment: Seeded bugs of et-7b: one per claimed behaviour and one per new trusted definition (tools/trust_map.py), in each language whose code the item changes. Each is an exact replacement of `old` by `new` in `file`; `test` must fail with it and pass without it. S mutants ran on a rebuilt, temporarily pinned ve_service with VE_NATIVE_PREBUILT=1 (without it the suite's own build fails first, at FillExamples' #guards); R mutants on the regenerated schema; pin and schema restored after each.

mutants.behaviour: an UNDECIDED alternative rendered clear (plan seeded bug 2); definition statusLabel
a Kleene-unknown alternative reported UNDECIDED without two validated fillings (plan seeded bug 3); C-class settleU
mutants.old: if C.length > budget then unknown .budget else
mutants.new:
if true then (⟨M, rows, r, a, .undecided, valid, hb, checked, hr, ha, F, filled, nofun, nofun, fun _ => sorry⟩, .fillings) else
    if C.length > budget then unknown .budget else

mutants.behaviour: the request's budget ignored; definition budgetOf
the scenario bound to the environment without its profile; definition runValidateU
a chooser with no clear alternative summarised as having one; definition chooserReportU
mutants.old: else if !(having .clear).isEmpty then s!"{r.2} has a clear action: {joined (having .clear)}"
mutants.new: else if !(having .notClear).isEmpty then s!"{r.2} has a clear action: {joined (having .notClear)}"

mutants.behaviour: UNDECIDED shown without saying the text does not settle it; definition statusPhrase
mutants.old: | (.undecided, _) => s!"{a.2} undecided: the text does not say whether it may be performed"

mutants.behaviour: agreement taken from the first assignment only; C-class agreed
mutants.old:
| some b :: bs => if bs.all (· == some b) then some b else none
  | _ => none

theorem agreed_all
mutants.new:
| some b :: _ => some b
  | _ => none

theorem agreed_all
mutants.test: lake build: VE.NormDefaults.agreed_all no longer proves
